executive_summary:
Episode 90 advances two distinct investigative threads within the Bride of Charlie series while devoting the latter third to non-investigative commentary on U.S. presidential rhetoric toward Pope Leo XIV. On the Tyler Robinson track, host Candace Owens presents and reads aloud from two court filings – the defense's Motion to Exclude Still Photography (filed March 30, 2026) and a state filing on forensic extractions of electronics – to argue that the federal arrest and booking timeline presented publicly is internally inconsistent with documentary timestamps. Specifically, the defense motion is read as showing Robinson being Mirandized at 6:25 p.m. on September 11, 2025, with attorney Doug Terry named, before the official public timeline indicates police had identified a suspect. A second filing excerpt is read aloud in which the state concedes it does not intend to offer forensic-extraction evidence from seized electronics at the preliminary hearing.

On the Turning Point USA / Erika Kirk track, the episode re-plays the Aspen audio clip of "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA" and presents host testimony that two Aspen-event donors contacted her to deny the statement occurred. The host also reads an Andrew Kolvet interview clip in which Kolvet admits pitches were received for a "Charlie GPT" product, and plays an internal Alliance Defending Freedom CEO video plus references an internal ADF board slide showing Daily Wire CEO Caleb Robinson on the board. Pope Leo XIV and Donald Trump are treated through artifact-anchored Truth Social posts, a papal video response, and a Trump press-conference clip defending an AI image. Structural importance: this episode formalizes the Tyler Robinson filing-timeline discrepancy as an artifact-anchored claim rather than a host inference and adds the federal forensic-extraction question to the registry.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson Mirandized at 6:25 p.m. on September 11
claims.claim: The defense Motion to Exclude Still Photography records a Miranda advisement at the 3-hour-36-minute mark of an interview video, which the host identifies as 6:25 p.m. on September 11, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain certified copy of motion and underlying video exhibit; cross-reference timestamp with booking and arrest records.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson requested attorney Doug Terry during Mirandization
claims.claim: During the recorded Mirandization referenced in A-1948.1, Robinson asked to speak with attorney Doug Terry and noted Terry's office was closed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify attorney representation records and the authenticity of the cited interview timestamp.

claims.label: State does not intend to offer forensic-extraction evidence at preliminary hearing
claims.claim: In a state filing on preliminary-hearing evidence, the prosecution states it does not intend to offer evidence obtained through forensic extractions of electronics seized in the case, while reserving the right to show photographs of text-message contents captured from a device.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying filing directly and confirm language; assess chain-of-custody implications.

claims.label: Aspen audio contains the statement "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me"
claims.claim: An audio recording played in the episode contains the phrase "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me. Erika would do a great job."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate timestamp, venue, and speakers; obtain the unredacted video referenced by Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet stated pitches were received for "Charlie GPT"
claims.claim: In a recorded interview clip, Andrew Kolvet states that pitches for a "Charlie GPT" product were received multiple times.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the date and outlet of the interview; obtain full interview transcript; verify whether any pitch was accepted.

claims.label: ADF CEO acknowledged in internal video coordination with Erika Kirk regarding Candace Owens litigation
claims.claim: An internal Alliance Defending Freedom CEO video played in the episode references working with Erika Kirk's team on litigation strategy concerning Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the internal video; obtain the underlying ADF board materials.

claims.label: Caleb Robinson holds a board seat at Alliance Defending Freedom
claims.claim: According to host testimony supported by an ADF internal presentation, Daily Wire CEO Caleb Robinson sits on the ADF board of directors (one of approximately eight seats).
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check ADF public filings (Form 990, board roster) for Caleb Robinson's name and tenure.

claims.label: Trump posted on Truth Social attacking Pope Leo XIV as weak on crime
claims.claim: A Trump Truth Social post is read aloud in the episode calling Pope Leo XIV "weak on crime" and criticizing the Pope's positions on Iran, Venezuela, and criticism of the President.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Truth Social post and engagement metrics.

claims.label: Pope Leo XIV publicly responded with the message "blessed are the peacemakers"
claims.claim: In a video response played in the episode, Pope Leo XIV states his message is "blessed are the peacemakers" and that he does not view his role as political.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Vatican source video and transcript.

claims.label: Trump defended the AI image of himself as Jesus by claiming he thought it depicted him as a doctor
claims.claim: In a press-conference clip, Trump defends the AI image of himself as Jesus by stating he thought it depicted him as a doctor / Red Cross worker.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify clip against White House press transcript.

claims.label: Discord publicly stated no evidence Robinson planned the incident on Discord
claims.claim: In a Discord statement published in The Hill on September 12, 2025, which the host reads, Discord says it identified an account associated with the suspect but found no evidence the suspect planned the incident or promoted violence on Discord.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Discord statement and The Hill article for exact text.

claims.label: Search warrant records Tyler Robinson arriving at Washington County Sheriff's Office at 10:26 p.m. with parents
claims.claim: Host references a search warrant indicating Tyler Robinson arrived at the Washington County Sheriff's Office at 10:26 p.m. with his parents.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the search warrant docket entry and verify exact time/date stamps.

claims.label: Two Aspen donors told host Charlie never made the appointment statement at the event
claims.claim: Host testifies that two TPUSA donors who attended the Aspen investor retreat contacted her to state that Charlie Kirk did not make the "I appoint my wife" statement at that event, and that Erika Kirk was not mentioned in a smaller follow-up dinner.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and contact the donors for recorded testimony; obtain any contemporaneous notes or attendee lists.

claims.label: State claims forensic photographs of Lance Twiggs phone contents will be offered in lieu of forensic extraction
claims.claim: Per the filing excerpt read aloud, the state intends to offer two exhibits that used cameras to record the contents of text messages, rather than forensic-extraction evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain filing directly; assess admissibility standards for photographs-vs-forensic-extraction under Utah rules of evidence.

claims.label: Trump-Pope confrontation occurred during Easter 2026
claims.claim: Host places the Trump Truth Social attack on Pope Leo XIV and the papal response during the Easter period.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference dates with Vatican liturgical calendar and Truth Social post timestamps.

claims.label: Host contends federal investigation shows pattern of altered public statements
claims.claim: Host asserts (based on the Discord statement and subsequent federal characterization) that the federal government initially described the messages as Discord and later revised the description to iMessage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain all federal court filings referencing the messaging platform used; compare earliest FBI statements with later court filings.

claims.label: Host says her source reported local texts at about 7 p.m. that police had Tyler Robinson, an hour before the Cox press conference
claims.claim: The host says her source told her that around 7:00 p.m. people locally began receiving texts that police had Tyler Robinson and would pick him up in Warner Valley, 12 miles from St. George; she says this makes it strange that at 8:00 p.m. Governor Spencer Cox led a press conference with Kash Patel and Robert Bowles describing the suspect as on the run and releasing new stills.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the time-stamped local texts and dispatch logs for the Warner Valley pickup; compare against the 8:00 p.m. press-conference statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe that my source was on the money when they said that they knew it was Tyler Robinson at 7:00.

claims.label: Host Describes Cabot Phillips as Erika's Ex-Boyfriend and Daily Wire Employee Tied to the Fort Huachuca Description
claims.claim: The host says Cabot Phillips is Erika Kirk's ex-boyfriend and a current Daily Wire employee, and is the man Mitch described as someone he believed he saw with Erika at Fort Huachuca in September.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Phillips's employment record and any statement from him or from the witness Mitch confirming or denying that the description matched him.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika's ex-boyfriend, one of the many, uh current Daily Wire employee, who was featured on my podcast when Mitch gave a description of the guy that he believed that he saw with Erika at Fort Huachuca

claims.label: Host Says Cabot Phillips Did Not Answer Her Text Asking If He Was at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: The host says she texted Cabot Phillips before naming him on the podcast, asking for a yes or no on whether he was at Fort Huachuca, and that he chose not to answer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's text thread with Phillips and any later statement from Phillips about his whereabouts in September 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: You will recall that I texted Cabot Phillips before we mentioned him on the podcast, looking for a simple yes or no response.

claims.label: Host Says Cabot Phillips Told Her at a Playground That People Doubt His Son Because of Her
claims.claim: The host says that on a toddler playground Cabot Phillips confronted her, said of his child that "because of you, people don't believe that he is my son," and pulled down his lip to show a tattoo; she says she has never discussed his tattoos or the child's paternity on the show.
claims.investigative_direction: Only the host and Phillips can confirm the encounter; Phillips's own account would be the test.
claims.transcript_snippet: he goes, oh, really? Because of you, people don't believe that he is my son. Okay.

claims.label: Host Says She Believes the Child Is Cabot Phillips's and Never Said Otherwise
claims.claim: The host says she believes the child is Cabot Phillips's, says she never made a claim otherwise, and asks listeners to consider the matter closed.
claims.investigative_direction: Review earlier episodes for any host statement about the child's parentage to test 'never made the claim otherwise'.
claims.transcript_snippet: I want to also state that I believe that that is Cabot Phillips' child. I never made the claim otherwise

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Alleged Appointment Statement Was Made at an Aspen Investor Retreat Weeks Before His Death
claims.claim: The host says the alleged statement appointing Erika as CEO and chairman was made, according to Turning Point, literally weeks before his death at an investor retreat in Aspen in front of donors, after someone asked what would happen if he died.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the retreat date, attendee list and program to establish when and where the remark was said to be made.
claims.transcript_snippet: took the stage in Aspen um at this investor retreat where he was giving an update on the company, and he stood in front of a bunch of donors

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point Released Only the Audio and Declined to Show the Video
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point declined to show video of the alleged Aspen remark and released only audio, even though it had said it caught the moment on video.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Turning Point whether video exists and obtain the original recording with metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: When pushed, Turning Point declined to show the video. Instead, they chose only to release the audio.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff Refused to Show the Video and Called Her a Psychopathic Subway Killer
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff, when she asked for the video, said she was a "psychopathic subway killer that was wielding a knife" and said Turning Point would never show it because "it'll never be enough."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Neff statements (posts or messages) the host is paraphrasing and confirm the wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: He said that I was a psychopathic subway killer that was wielding a knife.

claims.label: Host Says the Aspen Claim Was Never Previously Located in Aspen on Her Show and Many Assumed the Hamptons
claims.claim: The host says the show had never said the alleged statement happened in Aspen, that most people assumed it happened in the Hamptons, and that it happened in Aspen.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare earlier TPUSA and Erika Kirk statements for the claimed venue of the remark.
claims.transcript_snippet: I guess I hadn't appreciated that we had never said that that happened in Aspen. Most people were assuming that that happened in the Hamptons. It did not happen in the Hamptons.

claims.label: Host Says the Two Donors Knew of Erika's AmFest Account but Not That Turning Point Placed the Remark at the Aspen Event
claims.claim: The host says the two donors had heard Erika at AmFest describe the statement but were not aware Turning Point was claiming it occurred at the Aspen event, and said Charlie never uttered those words there.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the donors through the host and compare their account with the AmFest remarks and the claimed venue.
claims.transcript_snippet: they were not aware that Turning Point was making the claim that the statement occurred at that event.

claims.label: Host Says the Term Charlie GPT Was First Used by Andrew Kolvet
claims.claim: The host says the term "Charlie GPT" was first uttered by Andrew Kolvet in an interview, in which he claimed that after Charlie died they had pitches from companies wanting to create such a product.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Kolvet interview and search earlier public uses of the term Charlie GPT.
claims.transcript_snippet: A term, by the way, that you should know was first uttered, Charlie GPT, in an interview by none other than our guy, Andrew Kolvet.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Been Pitched on an AI or Hologram Version of Herself
claims.claim: The host says she has been pitched on creating an AI Candace or hologram Candace so she would not have to attend so many places, and says she finds the hologram pitch more plausible than a voice product.
claims.investigative_direction: The host would need to identify who pitched her; no external check beyond her records.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've certainly been in places where they've pitched me on like AI Candace, hologram Candace because it helps you not have to go to so many places at once.

claims.label: Host Asks Whether Turning Point Accepted a Charlie GPT Offer Given the Donors' Account
claims.claim: The host says her question is whether anyone took up an offer to create a Charlie GPT, because Aspen donors tell her Charlie never said the line.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Turning Point and its vendors whether any Charlie voice or AI product was commissioned, and request contracts or invoices.
claims.transcript_snippet: My question is, did they take someone up on their offer to create a Charlie GPT because I cannot stress this enough, the donors who were in attendance in Aspen are telling me that Charlie never said this.

claims.label: Host Says Donors Report Charlie Never Raised Erika at Aspen and That Erika Was Not at the Presentation
claims.claim: The host says the donors told her that Charlie, on multiple occasions where he could have mentioned Erika, did not, that Erika was in Aspen but not at the exact presentation when questions were asked, and that a later dinner of about 12 people also did not mention her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the dinner guest list and the schedule of Erika Kirk's movements in Aspen from attendees.
claims.transcript_snippet: Apparently Erika was up in Aspen, but was not at this exact presentation when the questions were asked.

claims.label: Host Says the Donors Want the Video Released and Say Turning Point Is Lying About Aspen
claims.claim: The host says the donors told her to pursue the matter further because Turning Point is lying about the event, that it would be easy to release the video, and that they want it released.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the Aspen video from Turning Point and corroboration from additional attendees.
claims.transcript_snippet: It would be very easy for them to drop this video, and they want it dropped.

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff's Reaction Suggests an AI Program Was Used
claims.claim: The host says that if the donors are right, it would be evil that Turning Point used an AI program, and says Blake Neff's reaction to her suggests that they did because it is easier than releasing the video.
claims.investigative_direction: Forensic audio analysis of the Aspen clip; request the original device recording and chain of custody.
claims.transcript_snippet: If true, that they used an AI program, which Blake Neff's reaction to me, I've been around, suggests that they did because it's just so much easier.

claims.label: Host Says the Notion of a Fabricated Statement Implies a Plot to Remove Charlie and Install Erika
claims.claim: The host says that if the audio was made up, it would signify a plot to remove Charlie and then use a Charlie GPT to convince the world it was his dying wish for his wife to replace him.
claims.investigative_direction: This is the host's inference; the test is authentication of the audio and its origin.
claims.transcript_snippet: Because the notion signifies that there that there was a plot, a plot to remove Charlie, and then to use Charlie GPT to convince the world

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point Insisted Erika Was Raised by a Single Mother and That This Is Untrue
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point immediately and repeatedly insisted in interviews that Erika was raised by a single mother, and that the host has proven this objectively untrue.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the interviews where the single-mother description was used and compare with family and public records.
claims.transcript_snippet: they also kept insisting immediately and through various interviews that Erika was raised by a single mother.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Hated Ben Shapiro and That Erika and Kolvet Knew It
claims.claim: The host says she has proven that Charlie hated Ben Shapiro, that everyone knows it, and that Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet knew it.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Charlie-Ben communications and public statements (see earlier episode material) and ask Kolvet and Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: First and foremost, I have told you, I have proven to you many times over that Charlie hated Ben. Everybody knows that.

claims.label: Host Says Jeremy Boreing Softened the Charlie-Ben Rift on Piers Morgan
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing, the former CEO of Daily Wire, on his Candace tour appearance on Piers Morgan, hedged and tried to make it sound good that Charlie and Ben did not get along.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Piers Morgan interview with Boreing and read his statement on Charlie and Shapiro.
claims.transcript_snippet: even Jeremy Boreing when he went on his like Candace tour, uh kind of caged his response and tried to make it sound good that the two of them did not get along when he was on Piers Morgan.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Publicly Took Her Side After the 2024 Daily Wire Firing and Ben Lobbied Donors Against Her
claims.claim: The host says that after she was fired from Daily Wire in early 2024, Charlie took her side in a big public way, and Ben Shapiro then worked behind the scenes to get a network of Jewish donors and writers to pressure Charlie to distance from her over anti-Semitism.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify donors or writers who pressed Charlie in 2024 and obtain any contemporaneous messages.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben then set to work behind the scenes getting like the Jewish network of donors and writers to peer pressure Charlie to distance from me because of anti-Semitism.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Admitted in the New York Times Interview That He Effectively Forced Charlie to Interview Ben
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet admitted in the New York Times interview that he effectively forced Charlie to interview Ben Shapiro a few days before his death, and that Charlie did not like it and was upset with Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Times interview and check Kolvet's exact words about the Shapiro interview; ask Kolvet to confirm Charlie's reaction.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew admitted in that same New York Times interview that we just showed you that he effectively forced Charlie to interview Ben a few days before his death.

claims.label: Host Says Ben Shapiro Used Caleb Robinson to Get on Charlie's Show With Matt Walsh as a Two-for-One
claims.claim: The host says that after Charlie's death Ben Shapiro had Caleb Robinson negotiate for Ben to appear on Charlie's show, that only Matt Walsh was originally to appear, that Caleb proposed a two-for-one, and that Andrew Kolvet agreed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the booking communications between Daily Wire and the Charlie Kirk Show for the Walsh and Shapiro appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: they wanted to have only Matt Walsh on the show, and Caleb said, "Well, how about a two-for-one special?" Andrew Kolvet agreed to do that.

claims.label: Host Says Ben Shapiro Demanded on His Show That Erika Sue Her Over the Trailer
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro went on his show and demanded that Erika sue her for releasing a two-minute trailer, which she says contains only Erika's own words.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Shapiro show segment and quote his statement on Erika suing.
claims.transcript_snippet: He went on his show and he demanded that Erika sue me for dropping a 2-minute trailer.

claims.label: Host Says Ben Shapiro Has Been Suing Her in Arbitration for Two Years
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro has been suing her for two years in arbitration court, so that the filings are not publicly readable.
claims.investigative_direction: Arbitration is generally non-public; confirm existence of the proceeding through the parties or any court filings to compel or confirm arbitration.
claims.transcript_snippet: This is after he's been suing me for 2 years, okay? In arbitration court so people can't read

claims.claim: The host says she received a flurry of emails last week from people at Alliance Defending Freedom saying Ben Shapiro is working with Erika on ways to sue her and has become suddenly influential at ADF, as has Seth Dillon.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the emails and identify the senders; ask ADF to confirm or deny any coordination with Shapiro or Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: you know, Ben is working with Erika on ways to sue you. He's He's become suddenly very influential in Alliance Defending Freedom.

claims.claim: The host says her ADF sources told her the public is not aware that Daily Wire quietly took a seat on the ADF board of roughly eight seats, as proof that Daily Wire was driving the effort.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare ADF's published board list and Form 990 with the internal slide.
